description: Single source of truth for the Tauri 3 upstream line carried by the monorepo. Versions live in root Cargo.toml [workspace.dependencies] and package.json workspaces.catalog; this file records tracked refs, the crates/packages to sync, the gate and the local patches. Driven by `bun run desktop:sync`. The cargo gate packages, generated paths and per-app config files live in tools/config/tauri-apps.json.

policy.rationale: Pin released alphas with exact `=` requirements; use a git/path patch only for a documented, upstream-missing fix (see patches).

patches.rationale: tauri-apps/tauri#16189 (open, 2026-10-05): on Linux Chromium's MessagePumpGlib work source returns a zero timeout under external_message_pump, so the winit-gtk4 event loop spins the main thread at 100% of a core while idle. The reporter's fix (destroy that source after cef::initialize) took the process tree from about 105% to about 3% of a core idle on the reporter's machine; the Aphrody measurement is in MEMORY.md. Re-based from alpha.4 to alpha.5 line numbers; carried by three vendor.toml rewrites.
patches.disposition: drop the patch and its three vendor.toml rewrites once a published tauri-runtime-cef fixes #16189

patches.rationale: The Linux bundlers (deb, rpm, AppImage) shipped only the en-US locale paks of the CEF distribution. The French paks (and gender variants, when present) now ship so Chromium's own strings follow a French session; the runtime locale stays unset. Carried by vendor.toml rewrites.

retired.retiredBecause: tauri 3.0.0-alpha.3 tauri-runtime-wry already ships no_redirection_bitmap (WindowBuilder and config); crates/ui/model-view uses it unchanged.

retired.change: none (identical to tauri-apps/plugins-workspace v2 at that commit, ahead 0)
retired.retiredBecause: no local change; replaced by crates.io 3.0.0-alpha.2 plugins.

retired.change: aphrody-wry, aphrody-tao, aphrody-tao-macros, aphrody-tauri-runtime-wry, aphrody-tauri-driver, the gtk3 feature of aphrody-tauri, libappindicator and the GTK 3 / webkit2gtk dependencies of tauri-plugin-mcp-bridge
retired.retiredBecause: Owner order 2026-10-05 (plan decision 21): one desktop runtime, tauri-runtime-cef (CEF + tauri-winit + GTK 4). tauri-driver only proxied WebKitWebDriver and msedgedriver and set TAURI_WEBVIEW_AUTOMATION, which only the wry runtime read; CEF is driven over CDP (RemoteDebugging, Playwright connectOverCDP). Debugger survey entries for WebView2, WebKitGTK and WKWebView are retired with it.

debuggers.policy: Bridge build input is a integrated patched crate in crates/ui/tauri-plugin-mcp-bridge. Debugger repositories are reference entries read live; no debugger Git clone is required. Archived fork metadata records provenance only.

forks.name: mcp-server-tauri
forks.forkStatus: created 2026-10-01 with gh repo fork --clone=false; nothing pushed
forks.tauriSupport: Tauri 2 only. tauri-plugin-mcp-bridge 0.13.0 depends on tauri = "2" and tauri-plugin = "2"; no v3 branch, no Tauri 3 issue. Same revision that m3/docs/research/integrations/tauri-mcp-parity.md already uses as the tool-name reference.
forks.notes: Rust bridge plugin (packages/tauri-plugin-mcp-bridge: WebSocket on 0.0.0.0:9223-9322 by default, no auth, no Origin check - upstream issue #36) plus a Node MCP server (packages/mcp-server, @hypothesi/tauri-mcp-server) whose DOM/a11y scripts are plain JS reusable from a Rust MCP. Harden before use: bind 127.0.0.1, per-process token, Origin check, cfg(debug_assertions) + cargo-feature gate. Patch list for Tauri 3 is in the survey.

patches.wiredIn: crates/ui/tauri-wrap (aphrody-tauri-wrap, module debug, feature debug-bridge) via workspace path dependency to the patched registry archive outside the repository.
patches.covers: Survey patches P1 (Cargo.toml pins), P3 (initialization_script), P4 (downcast_ref to tauri_runtime_wry::Webview; Windows and macOS call sites unverified), P6 (eval_with_callback polling instead of the __script_result IPC round trip), P7 (no committed command permission files needed), P8 (loopback default, Host/Origin checks, per-process token, ephemeral port with an on_listen hook). IPC trace events are kept in a page-side ring buffer, so no capability or permission is needed in the host app.
patches.notStarted: P5 (CEF in-process CDP): CEF apps attach over CDP directly (RemoteDebugging::Port), see docs/guides/web/TAURI-DEBUG.md
patches.status: Linux consumer check passed 2026-10-03 with the freshly restored crates.io archive: cargo check -p aphrody-tauri-wrap --no-default-features --features debug-bridge --locked. Windows/macOS and runtime behavior remain unverified.
patches.regenerate: Diff pristine crates.io 0.13.0 archive against the patched package; apply patch -p1 in the extracted package.
patches.cefPort: 2026-10-05 (decision 21): the registry patch is a further local change: the per-platform screenshot modules (WebKitGTK, WKWebView, WebView2, Android, iOS) and their dependencies are replaced by one CDP backend, crates/ui/tauri-plugin-mcp-bridge/src/screenshot/cef.rs (Page.captureScreenshot through tauri_runtime_cef). The committed patch files stay the provenance of the upstream diff.

forks.name: tauri-plugin-webdriver
forks.forkStatus: created 2026-10-01 with gh repo fork --clone=false; nothing pushed
forks.tauriSupport: Tauri 2 only (tauri = 2.10.0, tauri-plugin 2.5.3 in Cargo.toml 0.2.3). No Tauri 3 branch.
forks.notes: In-process W3C WebDriver server (axum, 127.0.0.1:4445) on WKWebView/WebView2/WebKitGTK/Android/iOS using with_webview native APIs; needs no external driver and no CDP port, so it is the macOS option and is not affected by the WebView2 Runtime 150 elevated-host hardening. 13 with_webview call sites need the Tauri 3 downcast_ref patch.
forks.access: reference upstream `tauri-plugin-webdriver`: aphrody git upstream read tauri-plugin-webdriver <path> (no local checkout since 2026-10-02)

forks.name: victauri
forks.forkStatus: created 2026-10-01 with gh repo fork --clone=false; nothing pushed
forks.tauriSupport: Tauri 2 only (workspace tauri = "2", victauri-plugin enables the wry feature that Tauri 3 removed; uses plugin Builder::js_init_script renamed in Tauri 3 alpha.2). No Tauri 3 branch.
forks.notes: Rust-native design closest to the aphrody-mcp Tauri tools (rmcp, axum, embedded streamable-HTTP MCP on 127.0.0.1:7373, Bearer token on by default, DNS-rebinding Host check, 403 on browser-initiated Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site requests, rate limits, whole server behind cfg(debug_assertions)). Young project (created 2026-04-25, 5 stars, AI-assisted authorship per its branch names): read for its hardening and tool surface, do not depend on it for release gates.
forks.access: reference upstream `victauri`: aphrody git upstream read victauri <path> (no local checkout since 2026-10-02)
